title: Keep constructor values when a join returns duplicate column labels
summary: With duplicate id labels, both the record and the final-field class now retain the first id, 1. Changing the decoy to 200 left the counting id setter untouched and still populated note.

change.description: SimplePropertyRowMapper suppresses setters and fields for properties already filled by the constructor, including when the same label occurs at a later column index.

notes: On the parent the record threw and the final-field class silently retained 100. Each positional oracle and typed projection executed through JdbcClient against H2.
